opportunities.title: Reliable, uncapped visitor chat for solo founders and tiny online businesses
opportunities.statement: Although many chat tools (mobile companions of SMB live-chat suites, free and open-core widgets) let small sellers talk to site visitors, reliable mobile alerts and replying without conversation caps or paid branding removal remain poorly served for solo founders and 1-5 person online businesses, because incumbents gate volume and branding behind tiers priced for support teams. This matters because users report missed or misrouted chats, lockout after caps or cancellation, and switching (EV-000032, EV-000037, EV-000043).

icp.description: Solo founders, indie app and plugin developers and other 1-5 person online businesses that answer their own site visitors and customers, mostly from a phone (most verified reviewers are general small businesses, not developers)

where_they_gather.channel: Widget 'powered by' badge on customers' sites

jtbd.job: Converse with site visitors and customers through an embedded chat widget and a mobile reply app

outcomes.statement: Minimize the number of visitor messages missed or sent to the wrong conversation when away from the desk
Minimize the likelihood of losing the ability to reply once a plan limit is reached or a plan is cancelled
Minimize the page-speed cost of the embedded chat widget on the seller's site

pricing_hypothesis.model: flat monthly subscription with a free tier
pricing_hypothesis.basis: Price ladder of site-chat incumbents' minimum paid tiers in gaps/sizing.json (chatim.app 9.0 to getfernand.com and ThriveDesk 29.0); card A2 tests 9 USD/month. Free unlimited tiers (Tawk.to, Umnico, Chatway free) push willingness to pay down.

in_scope: no conversation cap and no branding paywall on the paid plan
mvp.notes: Widget, inbox and websocket backend are routine for a coding agent; a reliable native mobile app with push delivery guarantees (the core promise) is harder and needs device testing by the human. Human ops burden judged medium against ~5 h/week.

experiments.hypothesis_xyz: At least 30% of 40 solo founders using a site chat tool, recruited in indie communities, will report a missed or misrouted visitor message in the last 30 days.
experiments.metric: share of interviewees reporting a missed or misrouted message in the last 30 days
requires_ht: recruit and interview founders in indie communities

experiments.hypothesis_xyz: At least 4% of 200 landing-page visitors from indie communities will start a paid checkout at 9 USD per month.
requires_ht: post the landing page in communities

experiments.hypothesis_xyz: At least 1% of visitors who click a widget's 'powered by' link will create a free account within 7 days.
experiments.metric: free accounts within 7 days / badge clicks
requires_ht: install the widget on real sites

gtm_channels.note: red team: simple-widget launches drew almost no attention

gtm_channels.channel: 'powered by' badge on customers' widgets (growth loop, untested)
Apple App Store companion app listing

kill_criteria: EXP-02 upper confidence bound below 4% paid-checkout starts
EXP-01 upper confidence bound below 30% reporting a missed or misrouted message
Prototype push delivery below 99% of 1,000 messages within 30 seconds
Support load above 5 human hours a week during the trial
An incumbent removes caps or branding on its cheapest plan
risks: Free tiers with unlimited chats (Tawk.to, Umnico, Chatway free) keep solo founders from paying
Push delivery no more reliable than incumbents (APNs/FCM throttling, iOS background limits)
Always-on support load exceeds ~5 human hours a week
Badge loop brings mostly free-tier users; ~110 customers at 9 USD needed for 1,000 USD MRR
Agent-built clones (ChatSpark, GhostChat, Libredesk) copy any wedge quickly
Platform dependence on APNs/FCM and App Store review (platform risk 1)

sizing.accounts_source: WordPress.org active installs only (crisp 20,000; tawkto-live-chat 100,000; tidio-live-chat 70,000); Shopify, Webflow and custom sites not counted; installs are sites, not 1-5 person businesses

assumptions.text: Solo founders who run site chat miss or misroute visitor messages often enough to want to switch tools.
Solo founders will pay for uncapped, reliable chat although free tiers exist.
A visible 'powered by' mark on the widget brings new sign-ups at no ad cost (growth loop).
Reliable mobile push delivery for chat can be built by an AI coding agent and run with about 5 human hours a week.

open_questions: A4 feasibility: will a prototype raise a phone notification for at least 99% of 1,000 test messages within 30 seconds over 2 weeks?
Are the buyers indie developers at all? Most verified reviewers are general small businesses.
Can any differentiation survive free unlimited incumbents and agent-built clones?

limitations: Desk research cannot predict virality or revenue; demand strength is capped at weak until validation experiments run.
